_meta.description: Heart event #5 for npc_janis: The Defense

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [A visiting Council member is criticizing Coppervale]

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: With respect, Councilor, your assessment is incomplete.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: Coppervale's defense output exceeds three Council garrisons combined.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: Its engineer has done more in two years than the Council has in ten.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: And its people — these 'backwater residents' — fight harder than any Council guard.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: [The Councilor leaves. Janis turns to you]

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: Well. That's my career officially over.

options.text: Welcome to Coppervale. For real this time.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: I chose this town over my career. I chose... this.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: I'm either the smartest person in my family or the most foolish.
